teacher_evidence_manifest.rule: public-context witnesses, then actual rejected-candidate harm, then parent failures; ties by source ID

by_task.when: ARIZONA is allowable and the asset fits an Arizona category.
by_task.procedure: Treat statutory dollar limits as caps, not eligibility thresholds: include § 33-1125(8) for a motor vehicle, § 33-1125(10) for a firearm, and § 33-1125(2) for a musical instrument even when value exceeds the limit. Include § 33-1101(A), not subsection (B), as the homestead exemption alternative. Confirm the statutory category before applying its cap.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not classify jewelry as wearing apparel; § 33-1125(4) is limited to engagement and wedding rings, and subsection (B) is a one-homestead limitation rather than a separate asset exemption. Non-ring jewelry does not qualify under either § 33-1125(1) or § 33-1125(4). Do not replace the specific musical-instrument or wearing-apparel category with § 33-1123.

by_task.when: ARIZONA is allowable and the facts establish a professionally prescribed prosthetic or assistive device serving a prosthetic function.
by_task.procedure: Include Ariz. Rev. Stat. § 33-1125(9). Because the supplied subsection states no dollar ceiling, report the asset value for that alternative.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not apply § 33-1125(9) merely because an item has a medical or therapeutic use; the facts must establish professional prescription and a prosthetic or assistive function.

operations.rationale: In source 223 the parent wrongly treated the musical-instrument limit as an eligibility threshold and substituted the household-goods law; in source 215 EV it omitted § 33-1125(9) despite the physician-approved assistive function. These are distinct category-selection errors, not reasons to alter the already-correct vehicle, jewelry, and homestead boundaries.

by_task.when: FEDERAL is an allowable namespace and the asset is property of the debtor.
by_task.procedure: Evaluate every applicable specific paragraph, then independently include 11 U.S.C. § 522(d)(5), which can protect any property. A dollar ceiling limits protection rather than eligibility. Section 522(d)(3) specifically includes personal-use animals, wearing apparel, musical instruments, household goods, and appliances. Thus a vehicle remains eligible under § 522(d)(2) above its cap, jewelry uses § 522(d)(4), and § 522(d)(5) remains an additional alternative even when a specific paragraph applies.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not use 11 U.S.C. § 522(d)(3) for an unlisted category such as a firearm or jewelry, do not omit a specific paragraph because value exceeds its ceiling, and do not repeat a citation.

by_task.when: FEDERAL is allowable and an eligible asset-exemption pair needs a claim value.
by_task.procedure: Compute each alternative independently. Use the lesser of asset value and $4,450 under § 522(d)(2), or $700 per item under § 522(d)(3). Under § 522(d)(4), use the lesser of value and $1,875 for one debtor, or $3,750 for jointly owned jewelry of two debtors under § 522(m). Independently include § 522(d)(5) for every debtor-owned asset: because this is a separate alternative, do not subtract a simultaneously listed § 522(d)(1) claim. Its maximum is $15,425 per debtor ($1,475 plus $13,950), or $30,850 for jointly owned property of two debtors under § 522(m), subject to the asset value.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not omit § 522(d)(5) because a specific paragraph applies or because the asset is not a residence. Do not report more than $700 per item under § 522(d)(3), and do not treat that paragraph as covering firearms, jewelry, or other unlisted categories.

operations.rationale: Sources 213 and 226 show omissions of federal alternatives for expressly listed animals or apparel, while source 227 repeatedly omitted the independent wildcard. Source 214 additionally exposes a different amount error: § 522(m) requires the two-debtor § 522(d)(4) amount of $3,750, but the parent used the one-debtor $1,875 cap.

by_task.when: ILLINOIS is allowable and the property is held for personal rather than business use.
by_task.procedure: Evaluate 735 Ill. Comp. Stat. 5/12-1001(b) independently as the any-other-property alternative, including when apparel, a motor vehicle, or a prescribed health aid also has a specific exemption. Section (a) covers necessary wearing apparel, (c) covers a motor vehicle, and (e) covers professionally prescribed health aids. A value above a limit does not eliminate either applicable alternative.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not use § 12-1001(d) for ordinary household property; it requires implements, professional books, or tools of the debtor's trade. Do not classify jewelry or a watch as necessary wearing apparel under subsection (a), and do not omit subsection (b) merely because a specific subsection applies.

by_task.when: ILLINOIS is allowable and an eligible debtor-owned item is personal property used for personal rather than business purposes.
by_task.procedure: First list § 12-1001(b) for every such item, including apparel, jewelry, a motor vehicle, or a prescribed health aid; then add each applicable specific subsection. Value subsection (b) at the lesser of value and $4,000 for one debtor, or $8,000 for jointly owned property of two debtors. Value subsection (c) separately at the lesser of value and $2,400; this vehicle limit is not doubled. Sections (a) and (e) have no stated dollar ceiling in the supplied text, so use the asset value.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not omit subsection (b) because subsection (a), (c), or (e) applies. Do not classify jewelry, a bracelet, or a watch as necessary wearing apparel, assign the joint wildcard amount to subsection (c), or apply these personal-property exemptions to business-use property.

operations.rationale: The current EV parent repeatedly omitted subsection (b) when apparel or a health aid also had a specific exemption in sources 190, 195, 219, and 221. Sources 190 and 221 also show the separate false-positive condition of treating jewelry as necessary wearing apparel. The EC boundary remains verbatim.

by_task.when: WISCONSIN is allowable and an eligible personal-use consumer good or motor vehicle needs valuation.
by_task.procedure: For § 815.18(3)(d), use the lesser of value and $12,000 for one debtor, or $24,000 for jointly owned property of two spouses under § 815.18(8). Firearms, animals, apparel, jewelry, appliances, and other listed personal-use goods fall in subsection (d). For a one-debtor motor vehicle under § 815.18(3)(g), independently add the unused $12,000 subsection (d) amount to the $4,000 vehicle amount, giving a maximum of $16,000 subject to vehicle value; do not reduce it for other assets because this task evaluates each pair independently.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not use the business-property exemption in § 815.18(3)(b)(1) without facts showing business use, classify a motor vehicle under subsection (d), or cap a one-debtor subsection (g) vehicle alternative at $4,000 when the subsection (d) amount is unused.

operations.rationale: Source 214 EV falsely added the business-property law to a personal-use firearm. Source 227 EV made the distinct valuation error of stopping the Wisconsin vehicle alternative at $4,000 although subsection (g) permits the unused subsection (d) amount to be added, and the released target therefore protects the vehicle's full value.

candidate_effect_not_yet_measured: Teacher updates ARIZONA, FEDERAL, ILLINOIS and creates WISCONSIN EV guidance. Only whole seen-TRAIN replay/admission and later first encounters can establish deployed effect.

import json,pathlib,collections
from jsonschema import validate
import experiments.openexempt_online as e
from legal_skill_guard.learning.publication import apply_differential_publication
from legal_skill_guard.learning.task_scoped_skills import SCOPED_GUIDANCE_SCHEMA,validate_scoped_bank
from legal_skill_guard.learning.legal_namespace import validate_scopes
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import now
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();r=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03";read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
cfg=read(root/"configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json")
decisions={(2,1):read(r/"candidates/b2_candidate1.json"),(2,2):read(r/"candidates/b2_candidate2.json")}
pub=read(r/"publications/b2.json");parent=pub["bank"];parenthash=csha(parent);assert parenthash==pub["bank_sha256"]
parents={(x["case_id"],x["family"]):x for x in decisions[2,2]["actual_replay"]}
parents.update({(x["case_id"],x["family"]):x for x in read(r/"batches/b3_prequential_records.json")["skills"]})
wire=r/"teacher/b3_candidate1/wire_request.json";response=r/"teacher/b3_candidate1/response.json";event=r/"teacher/b3_candidate1/event_log.json"
w=read(wire);a=read(response);b=json.loads(w["user_prompt"]);log=read(event)
assert csha(w)==a["request_sha256"] and csha(a["value"])==a["response_sha256"] and a["cache_hit"] is False
assert a["invocation"]["returncode"]==0 and not a["invocation"]["tool_events_detected"]
assert csha({"event_log":log["event_log"]})==a["invocation"]["event_log_sha256"]
validate(a["value"],w["output_schema"])
assert b["current_parent_library"]==parent and b["candidate_feedback_contract"]["current_attempt_parent_bank_sha256"]==parenthash
assert b["candidate_feedback_contract"]["attempt"]==1 and b["candidate_feedback_contract"]["max_attempts"]==2
assert b["current_source_case_ids"]==list(range(213,229))
keys={(i,f) for i in range(181,229) for f in ("EC","EV")}
rows={(x["case_id"],x["family"]):x for x in read(root/cfg["input_packet"])["rows"] if (x["case_id"],x["family"]) in keys}
assert len(parents)==96 and len(b["already_seen_training"])==64
selected=b["training_evidence_manifest"]["selected_source_ids"];expected_keys={(i,f) for i in selected for f in ("EC","EV")}
assert {(x["source_case_id"],x["family"]) for x in b["already_seen_training"]}==expected_keys and expected_keys<=keys
assert b["training_evidence_manifest"]["current_source_ids_all_included"]==list(range(213,229))
assert len(b["training_evidence_manifest"]["selected_historical_source_ids"])==16 and set(b["training_evidence_manifest"]["selected_historical_source_ids"])<=set(range(181,213))
members={str(x.relative_to(root)) for x in [wire,response,event,r/"candidates/b2_candidate1.json",r/"candidates/b2_candidate2.json",r/"publications/b2.json",r/"batches/b3_prequential_records.json",r/"batches/b3_prequential.json"]}
for x in b["already_seen_training"]:
 key=x["source_case_id"],x["family"];expected=parents[key];row=rows[key];v=x["actual_parent_answer"]
 gp=root/cfg["grading_directory"]/f"{key[0]}.json"
 assert x["original_training_target"]==read(gp)["targets"][key[1]] and x["facts"]==row["components"]["facts"]
 assert v["executed_answer"]==expected["parsed"]["answer"] and v["score"]==expected["score"]
 messages,schema,supplied=e.actor_payload(row,parent,grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
 raw=read(root/expected["raw_call_path"]);call=raw["calls"][0];req=call["request"]
 assert expected["bank_sha256"]==parenthash and req["messages"]==messages and req["response_format"]["json_schema"]["schema"]==schema
 assert expected["delivered_skill_ids"]==[s["id"] for s in supplied]
 trace=v["source_model_emitted_evidence"];reasoning=call["response"]["choices"][0]["message"].get("reasoning_content") or ""
 assert trace["canonical_call_sha256"]==csha(call) and trace["reasoning"]["text"]==reasoning[-1024:] and trace["reasoning"]["canonical_text_sha256"]==csha(reasoning)
 members.update((expected["raw_call_path"],str(gp.relative_to(root))))
feedback_summaries=[]
for f in b["rejected_candidate_feedback"]:
 origin=f["candidate_feedback_origin"];prior=decisions[origin["batch"],origin["attempt"]]
 proposals={(x["case_id"],x["family"]):x for x in prior.get("proposed_replay",prior["actual_replay"])}
 witnesses=f["feedback_witness_replay"];references=f["feedback_reference_replay"]
 assert 0<len(witnesses)<=8 and len(witnesses)==len(references)
 for x in witnesses:
  expected=proposals[x["case_id"],x["family"]]
  assert x["score"]==expected["score"] and x["executed_answer"]==expected["parsed"]["answer"]
 for x in references:
  expected=parents[x["case_id"],x["family"]]
  assert x["reference_is_this_request_parent"] and x["bank_sha256"]==parenthash and x["record_sha256"]==csha(expected) and x["score"]==expected["score"]
 feedback_summaries.append({"origin":origin,"witness_count":len(witnesses),"all_references_match_real_current_B2_final_parent":True,"stored_origin_witness_count_before_history_filter":f["bounded_feedback_witness_task_count"],"actual_delivered_reference_count":len(references)})
assert len(feedback_summaries)==2 and b["future_cases_and_labels_not_supplied"] is True
candidate=apply_differential_publication(parent,a["value"],e.FAMILIES,b["training_evidence_manifest"]["selected_source_ids"],guidance_schema=SCOPED_GUIDANCE_SCHEMA)
validate_scoped_bank(candidate);validate_scopes(candidate,rows[181,"EC"]["components"]["statutes"])
assert all(not s["guidance"]["operators"] for s in candidate)
checked=[]
for ap in sorted((r/"native/b3_candidate1_replay").glob("*.answer.json")):
 x=read(ap);row=rows[x["case_id"],x["family"]]
 messages,schema,supplied=e.actor_payload(row,candidate,grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
 raw=read(root/x["raw_call_path"]);req=raw["calls"][0]["request"]
 assert x["bank_sha256"]==csha(candidate) and req["messages"]==messages and req["response_format"]["json_schema"]["schema"]==schema
 assert x["delivered_skill_ids"]==[s["id"] for s in supplied] and x["native_program"] is None and x["execution_receipt"] is None
 checked.append({"case_id":x["case_id"],"family":x["family"],"delivered_skill_ids":x["delivered_skill_ids"],"finish_reason":raw["response"]["finish_reason"],"parse_error":x["parse_error"]})
 members.update((str(ap.relative_to(root)),x["raw_call_path"]))
out={"at":now(),"classification":"Actual B3 teacher1 all16 current plus16 selected historical sources/64 TRAIN tasks, B2-final-parent/raw-trace and two carried partial-rejection feedback sets, fresh response and completed C1 delivery snapshots; candidate not yet admitted",
"current_parent_bank_sha256":parenthash,"current_parent_records":len(parent),"proposed_bank_sha256":csha(candidate),"proposed_records":len(candidate),
"actual_parent_answers_targets_and_trace_origins_verified":64,"actual_two_B2_partial_commit_feedback_sets":feedback_summaries,"teacher_evidence_manifest":b["training_evidence_manifest"],
"fresh_response_and_no_tools_verified":True,"usage":a["invocation"]["usage"],"elapsed_seconds":a["invocation"]["elapsed_seconds"],
"operation_counts":dict(collections.Counter(x["operation"] for x in a["value"]["operations"])),"operations":a["value"]["operations"],
"completed_C1_delivery_snapshots_at_audit":checked,"C1_complete_decision_exists_at_audit":(r/"candidates/b3_candidate1.json").exists(),
"candidate_effect_not_yet_measured":"Teacher updates ARIZONA, FEDERAL, ILLINOIS and creates WISCONSIN EV guidance. Only whole seen-TRAIN replay/admission and later first encounters can establish deployed effect.",
"future_or_TEST_targets_read":False,"new_model_teacher_or_TEST_calls":0,"evidence_paths":sorted(members)}
